$comment: AMI-7301: the metering system of one LV feeder. Expected values in Maximo Monitor from the network model, the meter and transformer data; the head-end sends only what the meters measure.

identification.manufacturer: Landis+Gyr E350 customer meters, Itron ACE SL7000 check meter,
identification.model: PLC data concentrator and head-end system (AMI)
identification.description: Metering system of LV feeder 1 of a 250 kVA distribution substation: check meter, 24 smart meters, data concentrator
identification.customer_meter: Landis+Gyr E350 series 2 ZMF110Cx three-phase direct-connected meter with disconnector, 3 x 230/400 V, 5(100) A, IEC class 1 / MID class B, PLC communication module
identification.check_meter: Itron ACE SL7000 transformer-connected meter, class 0.5S, on 300/5 A CTs at the transformer LV terminals
identification.concentrator: PLC data concentrator in the substation (DLMS/COSEM over PLC to the meters, IP backhaul to the head-end system)
identification.transformer: 250 kVA 20/0.42 kV liquid-immersed distribution transformer, Dyn11, feeding this one LV feeder

network.source: Radial feeder: four 120 m sections to four street cabinets with 6 customers each, cable types from the network records. Resistances at 20 C: NAYY-J 4x185 SE 0.164 ohm/km, 4x95 SE 0.32 ohm/km (manufacturer data, = IEC 60228), service cable NYY-J 4x16 copper 1.15 ohm/km (IEC 60228 class 2). Corrected to 40 C with alpha = 0.00403 /K (commonly quoted for aluminium). Lengths, reactance 0.08 ohm/km, 40 C, pf 0.95, 420 V no-load voltage: assumption: typical value, replace with your network model (GIS), cable records and HES configuration.

transformer.source: Load and no-load losses: maximum values of Commission Regulation (EU) 548/2014 Table I.1, Tier 2, 250 kVA liquid-immersed (Ak 2350 W, A0-10 % 270 W). uk 4 % and the 0 % tap position: assumption: typical value, replace with your network model (GIS), cable records and HES configuration.

meters.customer_class: IEC 62053-21 class 1 / MID class B (MPE 1 % from Itr to Imax at +5 to +30 C)
meters.source: E350 series 2 technical data: voltage-circuit active power 0.45 W per phase (typical), not registered by the meter itself but seen by the check meter. Check meter: ACE SL7000 class 0.5S, CT connection Ib 1 A Imax 10 A (Itron brochure); CT ratio 300/5 A class 0.5S and concentrator consumption 5 W: assumption: typical value, replace with your network model (GIS), cable records and HES configuration.

load.source: Residential diversified load shape (night, morning and evening peaks) used by the stand-in only: assumption: typical value, replace with your network model (GIS), cable records and HES configuration.

demo.note: Demo only: the plant clock runs 90 times faster, so each published reading (every 10 s) is one 15-minute meter interval and a day passes in 16 minutes. The page opens at the visitor's local time.

twin_model.source: Unexplained loss 3 % and negative loss 2 % of the feeder energy, phase spread 8 points, neutral shift 8 V, busbar band 226-246 V, clock offset 10 s, coverage 99 %: assumptions (typical revenue protection and network practice). 207 / 253 V: 230 V +/- 10 %, the EN 50160 LV band as commonly quoted.

failure_modes.$comment: Each failure mode: what degrades, how it shows, the rules that see it.

bypass_theft.name: Meter bypass (energy theft)
bypass_theft.symptoms: feeder energy above the customer sum plus losses, on one phase; terminal cover opened

ct_polarity.name: Check meter CT wired reversed on L2
ct_polarity.symptoms: one phase registers as export; customers exceed the feeder

phase_mismapping.name: Wrong phase in the network model (cabinet C)
phase_mismapping.symptoms: total balance fine, one phase shows loss and another a gain

loose_neutral.name: Loose neutral connection in cabinet D
loose_neutral.symptoms: end-of-feeder phase voltages split apart; one goes high, one low

tap_setting.name: Transformer off-load tap set too high
tap_setting.symptoms: busbar and every meter high by the same amount

concentrator_comms.name: Data concentrator loses a PLC segment
concentrator_comms.symptoms: meters behind cabinets B and C not read; apparent loss is not real

clock_drift.name: Meter clock drift (sync failing)
clock_drift.symptoms: clock offset grows at every read; intervals shift

relay_stuck.name: Disconnector stuck closed
relay_stuck.symptoms: a meter commanded open still reports closed and registers energy
